answer: Each earning key must maintain a dedicated 2-MHz radio channel for 14 epochs and answer five beacon-timed chirps per epoch from three public receivers. Validators compare signed frequency, location, and latency traces; channels with matching oscillator drift or relay paths merge into one payout identity. A walnut boat may ride a tide beyond a dune, but every extra fake needs another licensed channel and 70 live replies, so 1,000 clones require 1,000 channels and 70,000 chirps. Two failed rounds burn that epoch's reward and freeze the cluster for four epochs.
